name: SedonaDB 0.5.0
body:
## What's Changed

* fix(ci): unbreak wheel tests and stop linux silently passing them by @james-willis in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1177
* feat(rust/sedona-functions): add the Sedona Spark ST_Force3DZ alias for st_force3d by @james-willis in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1162
* chore(r): Bump development versions to 0.4.1.9000 by @jiayuasu in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1181
* chore(dev/release): Fix crate publish order and add sedona-spatial-join-raster by @jiayuasu in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1180
* docs(dev/release): Document crates.io, PyPI, and verification pitfalls by @jiayuasu in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1182
* fix(rust): address Rust 1.98 Clippy lints by @jiayuasu in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1186
* chore(deps): Bump aws-lc-sys to 0.44.0 to fix jitterentropy build under conda-forge by @jiayuasu in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1185

* refactor(rust/sedona-raster): make ViewEntries the interface for passing views by @james-willis in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1196
* fix: require a spatial item in item_crs input matchers by @james-willis in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1194
* chore(deps): bump i_overlay from 8.0.0 to 8.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1191

* chore(deps): bump las from 0.9.10 to 0.11.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1200
* fix: make all-target tests portable by @paleolimbot in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1202
* feat(python/sedonadb): construct DataFrame from DataFrame by @paleolimbot in https://github.com/apache/sedona-db/pull/1209
